model_name: AMR Predictor — XGBoost Classifier (WHO GLASS 2022 Edition)
unit_of_analysis: Country-year-specimen-pathogen-antibiotic aggregate surveillance record (ecological level), NOT individual patient records.
intended_use: Educational/methodological prototype for country-level AMR surveillance risk-pattern analysis. NOT for individual patient diagnosis or treatment.

training_data.source: World Health Organization. Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS) report: 2022. Geneva: WHO; 2022. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO. https://iris.who.int/handle/10665/364996 Row-level compilation: Quentin Leclerc, https://github.com/qleclerc/GLASS2022
training_data.target: resistant (binary: PercentResistant >= 20.0, investigator-defined threshold, NOT an official WHO risk category)
training_data.coverage_caveat: Compilation includes only countries with continuous 2017-2020 data, plus separately all 2019 data; not a complete or fully representative sample of all WHO GLASS-enrolled countries.

limitations: Aggregate, country-level surveillance data, not individual patient records; predictions describe surveillance-reporting combinations, not patients.
The 20% 'High Risk' threshold is investigator-defined, not an official WHO cutoff.
No age, gender, or other patient-level variables are present in this dataset.
Coverage caveat above applies; results should not be read as globally representative.
